description: Return the fixed vocabularies `search_jobs` accepts (work models, employment types, experience levels, company categories, languages, sort orders, ATS sources), with live counts for the common ones. Call this when you are unsure what a filter accepts, or to size the index before narrowing a search. Values are canonical — use them verbatim. For companies, occupations, job categories, skills and industries use `find_companies` and `find_filter_values`.
name: list_filters
title: List available filters
